housing.summary: Numbeo reports EUR 924.67 monthly for a one-bedroom apartment in Pisa city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Pisa . The University of Pisa says private-rental deposits are generally two or three months and identifies Cerco Alloggio as the DSU lodging-search service: https://www.unipi.it/ateneo/rapporti-internazionali/info-e-servizi-di-accoglienza/alloggi-per-studenti-e-ospiti-internazionali/ .

banking.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo states that opening its online current account requires a valid identity card, driving licence, or passport plus a valid tax code or health card.
required_docs: Valid identity card, driving licence, or passport
Valid Italian tax code or health card

schools.summary: Westminster International School in Pisa states that it is an IB World School offering the IB Primary Years Programme for ages 3-12. MumAbroad provides a Tuscany and Umbria international-schools directory that includes Pisa schools.

legal_admin.summary: A foreign citizen never previously resident in Italy can request first anagrafe registration by submitting a residence declaration to the competent municipality through the ANPR residence-change service.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit a residence declaration for first anagrafe registration to the Comune di Pisa through the ANPR residence-change service.

tax_finance.summary: The Italian tax identification number is the codice fiscale. First-time EU and non-EU applicants must book an in-person appointment; depending on status it is assigned by the Immigration Single Desk, Questura, or an Italian Revenue Agency office.

transport.summary: Autolinee Toscane describes Pisa's urban network at https://www.at-bus.it/en/pisa and lists the Pisa-valid Urbano capoluogo monthly pass at EUR 42.20 at https://www.at-bus.it/en/ticket/urban-passes/urbano-capoluogo-monthly-pass . Italy's transport ministry explains licence exchange at https://www.mit.gov.it/conversione-patente-estera . Tuscany's PAeSI portal explains SSN registration at https://www2.immigrazione.regione.toscana.it/?q=risorsepertema&tema=Servizio+Sanitario+Nazionale&temaid=257 .
transport.network_name: Autolinee Toscane urban network of Pisa
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences with an EU-compliant expiry remain valid until expiry and are then converted at a Motorizzazione Civile office; a non-EU/EEA licence is usable for up to one year after Italian residence with an international permit or official Italian translation, and conversion after that is available only where a reciprocity agreement applies, otherwise an Italian licence must be obtained by examination.
transport.healthcare_registration: Register with the Servizio Sanitario Nazionale at the ASL for the place of residence or actual abode; registration provides a health card and choice of a family doctor.
